paper_reference: Packer et al., MemGPT: Towards LLMs as Operating Systems, and the Letta open-source implementation.
installation_command: git clone https://github.com/letta-ai/letta.git external/letta && git -C external/letta checkout b76da9092518cbaa2d09042e52fdcbde69243e18 && python -m venv external/envs/letta && external/envs/letta/bin/pip install -e external/letta
isolation: Use a dedicated virtual environment under external/envs/letta or a container. Keep server state and agent memory under external/ or artifacts/, not Git.
model_retriever_requirements: Official Letta server/client at the pinned commit.
Configured local Ollama/vLLM provider and memory store.
A JSON-stdin runner wrapper that creates or reuses a pinned native agent configuration.

expected_output_mapping.stdin: JSON object with baseline_id, comparison_mode, session_id, query, target_time, evidence, budgets, and native_config.
expected_output_mapping.stdout: JSON object. Required: answer or final_answer. Optional: predicted_state/state, confidence, predicted_hypothesis_id, citation_supported, input_tokens, output_tokens, cost_usd.
expected_output_mapping.native: Wrapper should run a native Letta/MemGPT agent with official memory behavior.
expected_output_mapping.controlled: Wrapper may load only the common evidence into the official memory substrate before answering.

readiness_notes: Native memory server startup and persistent state cleanup are outside tests. Hosted model providers are not permitted by this plan.

state_support.abstain: unsupported unless the agent explicitly refuses or emits no-answer
state_support.disputed: unsupported unless a custom official-agent state is emitted by the wrapper
state_support.unknown: evaluator_derived when no native state is emitted
